Subject: Private deployment — operator acceptance & hardened profile request

Sean,

Thanks for taking our call this week. As discussed in Section 7 of our RFP, we need a concise operator acceptance criteria pack and a hardened deployment profile for on-prem / VPC / air-gapped installs. Specifically we need:

- Operator acceptance checklist (credentials, oncall, operator rotations, provisioning steps)
- Patching and CVE remediation SLAs and example maintenance windows
- KMS/HSM integration options and sample key lifecycle flow
- Audit log schema, retention guarantees, and how telemetry can be exported to our SIEM
- A short runbook excerpt showing failover/restore for a degraded node scenario

Can you send a single reply with the above items and any supporting artifacts (network diagram, runbook excerpt, hardened profile)? Procurement would like this by end of week if possible — their timeline is tight.

Also include any items that typically require exceptions (SLA, port egress, operator remote access).

Appreciate it,

Dave Lin
Director, IT Architecture
Acme Health
[dave.lin@acmehealth.com]

Dave — attaching the consolidated packet and calling out the few items that typically require explicit exceptions during procurement. Thank you for the clear RFP section callouts; we mapped each requirement to an artifact in the packet.

Summary answers (short):
- Operator acceptance checklist: included (operators_acceptance_checklist.md excerpt). Key items include operator role matrix, MFA for operator sessions, operator rotation cadence, and documented oncall handoff process.
- Patching / CVE remediation: we recommend a tiered SLA (critical 7 days, high 30 days, medium 90 days). For on-prem air-gapped installs we provide a signed security bulletin package; customers pick one approved maintenance window per month for non-critical updates. See patch_window_matrix.xlsx.
- KMS/HSM: support both customer-managed KMS and HSM-backed keys. Attached flow shows provisioning + rotation. For fully air-gapped installs we can provide an HSM export process; keys are never persisted to Redwood control plane in that mode.
- Audit logs / telemetry: audit schema included; retention configurable up to 7 years. We support forwarding to customer SIEM via syslog/HTTPS collector.
- Runbook excerpt: included (operator_runbook_excerpt.txt) — contains node failover and cache-population recovery steps.

Exceptions / procurement items:
1) Egress for provisioning: install requires temporary outbound access to our provisioning CDN (443 and 9443) or a manual offline bundle — this is the most common exception.
2) Operator remote access: we prefer customer-hosted bastion or VPN; if Redwood remote access is required, it must be scoped and logged via customer-managed SSO and just-in-time elevation.

Attachments in this reply: hardened_deploy_profile_v1.pdf, operator_runbook_excerpt.txt, network_diagram_v2.png, patch_window_matrix.xlsx.

Shared links (read-only): https://drive.redwood.example.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cHardenedProfile
SLA exception form (DocuSign): https://docusign.com/ACM-7891-SLA-exception

Best,
